title: Three Presents
logline: Augustine's philosophy of time as memory, attention, and expectation turns out to be a nearly literal diagram of an AI token stream—until the gaps, memory, and multiplicity pull human and machine apart.

shots.what: Cold open: a wide 'now' band gets sliced finer and finer until it collapses to a hairline amber slit; ~0.1 s perceptual lag bridges recent past and guessed future.
shots.why: Exact geometric bisection and crisp typographic timing locked to narration.

shots.what: Augustine Book XI: hard origin boundary ('no before') and Pusey's admission ('If no one asks me, I know; if I wish to explain it, I know not').
shots.why: Clean architectural line work and exact public-domain serif typography.

shots.what: The puzzle of measurement: past gone, future not yet, present zero-width—yet crisp calipers measure a long span and a short pause across the bar.
shots.why: Precision geometric calipers transforming the same horizontal time bar.

shots.what: Distentio animi: the canonical three-zone bar (MEMORY | ATTENTION | EXPECTATION); words of a recited psalm flow through the narrow amber attention slit from expectation into fading memory.
shots.why: Frame-exact word flow through a slit synced to aligned narration cues.

shots.what: Scaling the stretching: the three-zone bar zooms smoothly outward through three scales—one line, a whole life, all of human history—while the amber slit holds center.
shots.why: Continuous mathematical scale morph of the central bar motif.

shots.what: AI voice enters: the bar transforms into discrete tokens—uniformly lit context window (memory), ranked next-token probability spread (expectation), and literal ATTENTION slit.
shots.why: Exact monospace tokens, probability bars, and attention connector lines.

shots.what: No time between messages: the bar shears into timestamps 11:55, 12:04, 12:07 and the silent gaps collapse to zero width—no before until you speak.
shots.why: Crisp mechanical collapse of temporal gaps with exact timestamps.

shots.what: Postmark & diary: a hard MID-2026 training boundary and flat archived note cards replace lived fading memory on the left of the slit.
shots.why: Architectural contrast between lived gradient decay and flat indexed cards.

shots.what: Many recitations at once: the single bar and amber slit multiply vertically into parallel independent three-zone bars running simultaneously.
shots.why: Synchronized procedural multiplicity of the central motif.

shots.what: Coda: Augustine's scattered vs. gathered; resolves onto two quiet three-zone bars side by side (HUMAN and AI) sharing the amber attention slit, ending on 'I honestly can't tell.'
shots.why: Quiet typographic stillness and clean symmetry comparing the two minds.
